## Activity

During October 2020, River Outreach recorded 26 captures. This activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance for the month. The capture total should be considered alongside the number of images that could not be assessed and the results that required referral.

## Image quality

Image quality review identified 5 ungradable captures, representing an ungradable rate of 19.2. The rate indicates that a proportion of the material submitted for review could not be graded. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk to support follow-up and help reduce avoidable losses in image usability.

## Grading

Grading identified 4 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1. This provides an overall measure of turnaround for the month, while the referable findings indicate the volume requiring further attention. Activity, image quality, and grading results should be reviewed together when monitoring the site’s operation and identifying any actions needed to improve the capture and review pathway.
